sentences.zh: 弗吉尼亚理工大学大屠杀发生三个月后，伊利诺伊州的一名枪械经销商拿起电话，拨打了美国烟酒枪炮及爆炸物管理局的电话。

sentences.en: Three months after the Virginia Tech massacre, an Illinois gun dealer picked up the phone and called the Federal Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, and FirearMs.
sentences.zh: 他告诉一名探员，他担心一个试图购买枪支的客户。

sentences.en: He told an agent that he was worried about a client who was trying to purchase guns.
sentences.zh: 这是他成为枪械经销商大约10年以来，第一次向ATF进行举报。

sentences.en: It was the first time he'd ever made a report to the ATF in, I think, about 10 years of being a gun seller, a gun dealer.
sentences.zh: 汤姆·吉本斯是伊利诺伊州麦迪逊县的国家检察官。

sentences.zh: 汤姆说，联系枪械经销商的那名男子情绪激动且态度坚决。

sentences.en: Tom says the man who'd contacted the gun dealer was agitated and adamant.
He said he needed the guns quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且他购买的东西很不寻常。

sentences.en: And what he was purchasing was unusual.
sentences.zh: 他买的是三把低价的、完全相同型号的枪，一种半自动手枪，.380口径。

sentences.en: He was buying three low-cost, exact same models of a gun, a semi-automatic handgun, a .380 caliber.
sentences.zh: 枪械经销商解释说，这名男子名叫奥图森·奥德瓦莱，他在网上批发购买了这些枪支，

sentences.en: The gun dealer explained that the man, whose name was Olutosun Odewale, had purchased the guns wholesale on the Internet
sentences.zh: 并需要他这个有执照的中介来完成交易。

sentences.en: and needed him, a licensed transfer agent, to complete the transaction.
sentences.zh: 奥图森的背景调查很清白，但枪械经销商觉得有些不对劲。

sentences.en: Olutosun's background check was clean, but the gun dealer felt something wasn't right.

sentences.en: The ATF suspected Olutosun might possibly be a straw purchaser, someone buying guns for someone else.

sentences.en: But Tom Gibbons says police also considered more sinister motives.
sentences.zh: 拥有三把相同的武器，如果一个人打算做出有害的行为或实施大规模伤亡事件，

sentences.en: Having three identical weapons, if a person's going to do something harmful or commit a mass casualty event,
sentences.zh: 拥有三把相同的枪械的好处是能够使用相同的弹药，

sentences.en: having three identical firearms has the advantage of being able to use the identical ammunition,
sentences.zh: 无论你使用的是哪支枪，都可以为该弹药使用完全相同的弹匣。

sentences.en: to use the exact same magazines with that ammunition, no matter which of the guns you're using.
sentences.zh: 当然，购买多个低价武器可以让一个人同时拥有多把武器。

sentences.en: And, of course, buying low-cost, multiple weapons allows you to have multiple weapons available at a single time.
sentences.zh: ATF很快了解到奥图森是南伊利诺伊大学的一名学生。
